destination_story_translations.body: Founded in 1525, Santa Marta retains traces of its colonial port in the historic centre. The Cathedral and Customs House sit alongside the Indigenous heritage of the Sierra Nevada. Simón Bolívar died at the Quinta de San Pedro Alejandrino in 1830.

Santa Marta, fundada en 1525, conserva en su centro la huella del puerto colonial. La Catedral y la Casa de la Aduana dialogan con el patrimonio indígena de la Sierra Nevada. En la Quinta de San Pedro Alejandrino murió Simón Bolívar en 1830.

Fundada em 1525, Santa Marta conserva no centro as marcas do porto colonial. A Catedral e a Casa da Aduana convivem com o patrimônio indígena da Sierra Nevada. Simón Bolívar morreu na Quinta de San Pedro Alejandrino em 1830.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Tairona Gold Museum · Customs House
point_of_interest_translations.description: The Customs House brings together archaeological heritage and stories about the societies of the Sierra Nevada and Santa Marta. It adds cultural context beyond beaches and colonial history.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Museo del Oro Tairona · Casa de la Aduana
point_of_interest_translations.description: La Casa de la Aduana reúne patrimonio arqueológico y relatos sobre las sociedades de la Sierra Nevada y Santa Marta. Aporta contexto cultural al viaje más allá de las playas y la memoria colonial.

point_of_interest_translations.name: El Rodadero Aquarium and Sea Museum
